recent.text: Joel Embiid has 10 points, nine rebounds and five assists. He’s on pace to record his second triple-double in as many games against the #Bucks this season. He had 18 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists against them on Oct. 24. #Sixers. #ThrowTheBallUp

recent.text: After one: Bucks 30, Sixers 29. Sixers shook off another sluggish start to take the lead, but Labaron Philon Jr. fouled Tyler Herro on a three-point shot in the final seconds of the opening frame.

recent.text: Two early Anfernee Simons threes. The second one was aided by an impromptu Dominick Barlow screen – his feel for when to se those is excellent.
